easy.def: A place with lots of books you can borrow.
examples: I got a book from the library.
The library is a quiet place.
Our school has a library.

more.def: A place where books and other materials are kept for people to read or borrow.
examples: We go to the library every Saturday to choose new books.
You need a card to borrow books from the library.
The library offers story time for young children.

easy.def: The time from when you are born until you die.
examples: My grandpa had a long life.
A pet's life is short.
She has a happy life.

more.def: The state of being alive, or the time that a person or animal is alive.
examples: Plants and animals are living things, and they all have life.
A tortoise can have a very long life.
Scientists study life in the ocean.

easy.def: A bright flash of light in the sky in a storm.
examples: I saw lightning and then heard thunder.
Lightning hit the tall tree.
The lightning was so bright.

more.def: A bright flash of electricity in the sky during a storm.
examples: Lightning lit up the whole sky for a second.
Never stand under a tree when there is lightning.
We counted the seconds between the lightning and the thunder.

easy.def: To think something is nice and enjoy it.
examples: I like apples.
She likes to dance.
We liked the movie.

more.def: To enjoy something or to think well of someone or something.
examples: My brother likes to build models of airplanes.
Do you like the new teacher?
We liked the zoo so much that we visited again.

easy.def: The same as, or almost the same as.
examples: He runs like the wind.
You look like your mom.
It feels like silk.

more.def: Similar to something, or in the same way as something.
examples: The clouds looked like cotton balls floating in the sky.
She sings like a bird, with a clear and sweet voice.
A zebra looks like a horse with stripes.

easy.def: Something wet that you can pour.
examples: Water and milk are liquids.
Juice is a liquid.
The soap is a blue liquid.

more.def: Something that flows and can be poured, like water. It is not a solid or a gas.
examples: When ice melts, it changes from a solid into a liquid.
Honey is a thick liquid that pours slowly.
The nurse measured the liquid medicine in a spoon.

easy.def: To use your ears to hear.
examples: Listen to the birds sing.
I listen to music.
Please listen to the story.

more.def: To pay attention so that you can hear something.
examples: If you listen closely, you can hear the ocean from here.
We listened to the rain on the roof.
A good friend listens when you have a problem.
I have a little dog.
A little bird sat there.
She is a little girl.

more.def: Small in size or amount, or young.
examples: A little mouse squeezed through the tiny hole in the wall.
There is only a little milk left in the jug.
When I was little, I loved to play in the sandbox.

easy.def: To have your home in a place.
examples: I live in a house.
Fish live in water.
She lives near me.

more.def: To have your home in a place, or to make your home there.
examples: My grandparents live in a small town by the sea.
Polar bears live in the cold Arctic.
We lived in an apartment before we got a house.
Plants live and grow.
A turtle can live a long time.
We live and learn.

more.def: To be alive, or to stay alive.
examples: Some turtles live for more than a hundred years.
Plants need light and water to live.
He lived a long and happy life.
